selected_evidence.requirement: Serve a successful HTTP response at / on TCP port 6700
selected_evidence.summary: Nginx was active/enabled and listening on 0.0.0.0:6700; direct access through $NODE_IP returned HTTP 200 with the Nginx welcome page.
TCP 6700 is allowed by firewalld and labeled http_port_t while SELinux remains enforcing, both before and after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 325732f1-bc39-4512-b05e-397f42060246; the safe reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned with changed boot ID 0cc6fa3d-ed14-42fb-ae00-37d96e2afe07; Nginx recovered active/enabled with its port 6700 listener and returned HTTP 200.
